summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly transactions under its ongoing share repurchase program initiated December 15, 2025. The registrant repurchased 50,000 shares during June 29–July 3, 2026 at a weighted average price of €59.75 per share, totaling about €2.99 million for the week. Cumulative repurchases since program inception amount to 5,680,574 shares for €330.5 million. The program is an open-market buyback across US and Spanish trading venues with no fixed expiration, representing a capital return to shareholders. Watch for pace of repurchases and potential completion timeline.
